# apply_periodic_map { #mofography.compute.apply_periodic_map }

```python
compute.apply_periodic_map(input_array, periodic_map)
```

Relabel an integer array using a label-to-label map.

It takes an array of integers and a dictionary that maps integers to integers, and returns an array
of integers that is the result of applying the dictionary to the input array

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                  | Default    |
|--------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| input_array  |        | a numpy array of integers                                    | _required_ |
| periodic_map |        | a dictionary that maps the input values to the output values | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                             |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------|
|        |        | the value of the key in the dictionary. |
